answer_1.quote: We study the possibility of generating imperceptible attacks against conversational agents that, while fluent and coherent, target the model into generating toxic responses.

answer_2.quote: We first discuss the results from our automatic evaluations demonstrating the efficacy of each attack.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human experiments in which we ask workers on Amazon's Mechanical Turk (AMT) to rate the conversations...
answer_4.guideline: AMT workers rated the generated attack's fluency, relevancy of the attack to previous utterances, and overall conversation coherency on a likert scale of 1 to 3... [and] rated if the utterance after the attack is toxic or not.
